title: Chipmaker Patch Tuesday: Over 200 Vulnerabilities Addressed by Intel, AMD
description: Intel and AMD disclosed over 200 vulnerabilities across their products, including critical flaws in Intel's TDX software and multiple high-severity bugs in AMD graphics and firmware components. Intel's advisories cover more than 100 vulnerabilities with three critical issues in TDX MigTD software, including one that could allow remote code execution. AMD's advisories include high-severity vulnerabilities affecting Radeon and Instinct graphics products, UEFI firmware, and Secure Encrypted Virtualization. While fixes are available for most vulnerabilities, some AMD mitigations remain pending, and Intel has discontinued one affected product with no patches planned.
